content: Yahwe titiŋ didimeniŋ hogok tilak adi yadi kunumkwet diniŋ Molom

Yahwe, nu helemahelemaŋ welegedi nibukahile hinek tilaŋ wondok kap toluwaat. Tiŋa undugoŋ medege didimeŋgoŋ hinek takaliŋa faki-kabe nemu bikabulaŋ wondok maaŋ dapmandapmaŋnit mokit yohautawene metam ulihakaŋ hatitauneeŋ indigoŋ tuwot hali wooŋ halaak.
Nu agaŋ nadilat, du welegedi nibukahilelaŋ u waaniŋ hali wooŋ halaak. Medege didimeniŋ u bikabu-kabe nemu tubune kunumdi waaniŋ uŋgoŋ fafaŋeŋ hatak wondok tuwot hatak.
Du indiŋ yoguŋ, “Nu me niŋ agaŋ tubudakaleeŋ adigut mede yofolok tugumut. Nu kwanai-mene Dewitdok mede yofafaŋe tiŋa indiŋ niŋgut,
‘Me mapme kwanai adi du’walaŋ yalakigeye ulihakaŋ hatitaloneeŋ adi hogokdi hatiyaneeŋdok ganilat.’”
Yahwe, aŋelo kunum foloŋ hatiiŋ adi du kudi tuguŋ wendok youtumbaaŋ wohoge yotiloiŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ du mede yofafaŋeguŋ hogohogok u didimeŋgoŋ hinek takalilaŋ doktiŋa bophik gineŋ ganintiloiŋ.
Yahwe, kunum foloŋ nebek niŋ dutok tuwolit nemoŋ. Eŋ aŋelo niŋdi dutok tuwolit nemoŋ.
Aŋelo talitimeŋ heki adi Bepaŋ du gikiŋgoŋ tigamiiŋ. Eŋ aŋelo mohok noli du gehikelemadi tiiŋ adi dutok nadiune beweniŋgoŋ tubune gikiŋgoŋ tigamiiŋ.
Yahwe, Saŋiniŋ Molom, nebek niŋ du saŋiniŋge loloŋnit undiniŋ nemoŋ. Du helemahelemaŋ medege didimeŋgoŋ takalilaŋ, tiŋa undubu yoŋ undubu yoŋ adi mu tilaŋ.
Du imeŋgwaŋ saŋiniŋnit kadokolaŋ. Eŋ ime giyondaaŋ pilatak kaŋ tubukulemaune kulemaŋ hatak.
Du Isip’walaŋ
saŋiniŋ wapum u ubulagineeŋ tubukadakadapmaŋ tuguŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa saŋiniŋge wapum wendi memikgeye yehimoŋgofooŋ yehikelepupuheneguŋ.
Kunum gut kwet adi da’walaŋ hogok. Du kwet kameeŋ nemenemek wendok foloŋ hadapmaiŋ u maaŋ boiguŋ.
Kwet wahiŋkade be kumaŋkade u dagoŋ yehitubu-mintaguŋ. Kweboboe Tabo gut Hemon adi nadifo tiŋa kap toŋa wohoge youtumbayamuk.
Wapum, du’walaŋ saŋiniŋge adi wapum hinek, eŋ saŋiniŋge u yadi loloŋnit hinek.

Du mapme ila titiŋ didimeniŋ gineŋ metam yabudokolaŋ. Tiŋa mede nadiŋa yodapmaŋ kwanai didimeŋgoŋ hogok tilaŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ, metam hogohogok yabukahile tiŋa medege didimeŋgoŋ takaliŋa undubo yooŋ undubo yooŋ mu tilaŋ.
Metam kap toŋa ganiutumba tiiŋ, tiŋa hebeke foloŋ hatibune titiŋge fofooŋ hinekdi hauta nabugoŋ yehitubu-hautalak, adi yadi nadifo kedem tineŋ.
Adi yadi du titiŋ momooŋ tiyemguŋ wendok nadiŋa melenai indigoŋ tuwot, hadapmo be timiŋ adi nadifo tiŋa wohoge yotiloloŋ tiiŋ.
Du kubugoŋdi indi’walaŋ saŋiniŋnik loloŋnit. Wondoktiŋa siloŋ tobogoŋ tiŋa nihitubu-lodaune mik gineŋ fafaŋe tiyam.
Yahwe, du dagoŋ me nibudokodok tubudakaleguŋ. Du adi Isilaehi indi’walaŋ Bepaŋ, tiŋa titiŋ momooŋ eŋ titiŋ didimeniŋ hogohogok diniŋ Bepaŋ maaŋ. Dagoŋ Isilaehi inditok mapme nimguŋ.
Yahwe adi Dewit eŋ yalakiŋiye yabudokodok yofafaŋeguk

Koomkwaha polofetgeye damo gineŋ mintayemiŋa indiŋ yeniŋguŋ, “Me fafaŋeniŋ niŋ ki foloŋ mapme’walaŋ mebi mokop tehindilendileŋnit mokomiŋgut, metamneye’walaaniŋ niŋ tubudakaleŋa me loloŋnit kambiyakut.
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, nu tipilapilaye-mene Dewit tubumintagut. Unduŋ tiŋa yegut e ime wahu munduŋnit uŋgoniŋdi mapme iitdok yougomgut.
Kohonedi helemahelemaŋ honefafaŋeeŋ nagila hatiŋa kadokoluwaak. Kohone folooŋdi saŋiniŋ miluwaak.
Memik niŋdi adi talamulaŋa mu ulatifowaak. Eŋ me kadakaniŋ titiŋ niŋdi fafaŋeeŋ tuwot mu tiŋa fowaak.
Memikŋiye hebeŋ foloŋ widihidadagiyewaat. Eŋ adi kakwihitaneeŋ adi yadi yehiwenemadit tibaat.
Nu’walaŋ welesiloŋ eŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ adut hatuwaak. Eŋ nu’walaŋ wotnene foloŋ saŋiniŋ moŋgola yatuwaak.
Nu tubulodawene kweli kadokowaak adi Meditelenien imeŋgwaŋneniŋ tububihila wooŋ ime wapum Yufeletis uŋgoŋ wosuwawaak.
Kaŋ adi kutinaniŋa indiŋ yoluwaak, ‘Du Batne eŋ Bepaŋne. Dagoŋ helemahelemaŋ nabudokooŋ nehitubu-lodalaŋ.’
Kaŋ nu adi mihine biyeniŋ nindapmaaŋ kwetfoloŋ mapme heki’walaŋ loloŋnit kamewaat.
Siloŋ tobogoŋnedi tubukilitiŋa nagila hatiluwaat. Eŋ yofoloknedi fafaŋeniŋ halimiluwaak.
Nu yalakiŋiye yehitubu-ulihakawene yeuli dapmandapmaŋnit mokit hatuwaak. Tiŋa nu mapme kweli tubukilitiwene kunumdi hatak wondok tuwot ituwaak.
“Yalakiŋiye adi yadi Yodoko Medene wabiŋa mede yenindidime tilat u mu nobu takalineeŋ
tiŋa undugoŋ medene yofafaŋe tilat ulatifofoŋ nobu tineŋ
adi yadi tahi kwadidi yehitubu-didimewaat. Eŋ kadakaniŋhikdok tiŋa yehitubu-figitawaat.
Eŋ ne adi siloŋ tobogoŋne mu lomtibaat. Be siloŋne folooŋ u mu tubufilimimbaat.
Nu yofolokne mu fiyakulaat, eŋ manedi mede yofafaŋe tugut u mu wiyakulaat.
Nu na’walaŋ uŋgoniŋ hatihatine foloŋ kame ulodiŋa nai kubugoŋ yofafaŋe tugut wondi hahat fafaŋeniŋ. Nu Dewit yalaŋ nemu nimbaat.
Adi’walaŋ yalakiŋiye adi liwe mu tineeŋ. Eŋ mapme kwanaiŋiŋ adi namandatne foloŋ mele itak wondok tuwolit haliwooŋ halaak.
Muyakip kameŋit itak aditok tuwot itouluwaak. Kunum halaak tuwot iwamatawaak.”
Yobulabulaye Kap
Yofolok unduŋ tuguŋ iŋgoŋ yoŋ adi agaŋ wabiŋa mapme tubumintaguŋ u nadikwihita timilaŋ. Ime wahu munduŋnit youlimiŋguŋ aditok tiŋa kwihitadi walage fotoki tilak.
Tipilapilaye mege dut yofolok tugumuk u wiyakutaŋ. Tinahukutŋiŋ tehindilendileŋnit u tikulimimbune maaŋ kwam tuguk.
Du kawade gimbahaŋŋiŋ wiyakulimiŋguŋ. Yoli kweli fafaŋeniŋ wiyapupuheneguŋ.
Metam yaudapmaŋ tiiŋ hogohogok adi bomboŋŋiŋ kubo timiiŋ. Noliŋiye yamaŋgoŋ itowiiŋdi gikiŋgoŋ mu timiŋa nimpekit tiiŋ.
Memikŋiye nadiyembune fafaŋeŋ yalitifooŋ tonadifo tigiŋ.
Yakee, miknoŋŋiŋ mimim tubugenimbamiŋguŋ, unduŋ timiŋa yeguŋ e mik maaneŋ mu tubulodaguŋ.
Mapme saŋiniŋŋiŋ lomtiguŋ. Kumopopŋiŋ tehindilendileŋnit tapmetikukuŋ kaŋ kwetfoloŋ maaŋ hatak.
Nadifo foloŋ hatihati naiŋiŋ tubumuniŋgoŋ timiŋa folomeka eŋ bulaniŋgoŋ kamemiŋguŋ.
O Yahwe, du hebi hatige hatige nai deniŋ mintawaaŋ? Kwihitage diniŋ kudupmebem u deniŋ kumuŋa kulemawaak?
O Wapum, hatihatinik diniŋ nai muniniŋ hatak u mu nadilaŋ be? Meeniŋ hogohogok kumuŋ tiyam wondok nadisuweŋ.
Nediyeŋ hatitalogeloge kumuŋ kalakapmewaak? Eŋ nedi’walaŋ hatihatidi kumuŋ yokwet diniŋ saŋiniŋ ulatiŋafooŋ hatibaak.
Yahwe, du nai indidegoŋ mu nibukahilelaŋ be? Du koomkwaha Dewit nukut mede yofolok biyagoŋ tinamguŋ wondiniŋ folooŋ de?
O Wapum, tipilapilayege nanimpekit tiiŋ u maaŋbe nadilaŋ? Metam mu nadisukilitigamiiŋ adi nanimpekit tiŋa nanisilone tiiŋ.
O Yahwe, mede wondegoŋ nehitubu-meka tiiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa ime wahu munduŋnit nedegomguŋ nu talik hati yauluwene folomeka tinamiiŋ.
Yahwe, helemahelemaŋ hati niutumbadok. U biyagoŋ hinek.

footnotes.text: Hibulu mede gineŋ Lehap youkiŋ, adi Isiphidok nadiŋa youkiŋ.
